toast.snapshot:
As of May 30, 2026, here's a current snapshot of Toast, Inc.:

- **Size (approximate headcount):** 6,500 employees. ([paymentsdive.com](https://www.paymentsdive.com/news/inside-toasts-2025-hiring-binge/813462/?utm_source=openai))

- **Funding stage / market cap:** Public company with a market capitalization of approximately $15.67 billion.

- **Industry / what they do:** Toast operates in the fintech sector, providing a cloud-based, all-in-one digital technology platform tailored for the restaurant industry. Their services encompass point-of-sale systems, payment processing, and various operational tools designed to streamline restaurant management. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/tost/?utm_source=openai))

- **Culture & reputation:** On Glassdoor, Toast has an overall rating of 3.8 out of 5, with 69% of employees willing to recommend the company to a friend. The company has been recognized in Glassdoor's "Best Places to Work" list, ranking #17 in 2024 and #96 in 2023. Employee reviews frequently commend the company's culture and flexibility, though some note concerns about limited advancement opportunities and internal challenges. ([glassdoor.com](https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Toast-Inc-EI_IE989964.11%2C20.htm?utm_source=openai))

- **Recent news worth knowing:**
  - In 2025, Toast expanded its workforce by approximately 14%, adding 800 employees, bringing the total to 6,500. This growth occurred as other companies in the payments sector were reducing staff. ([paymentsdive.com](https://www.paymentsdive.com/news/inside-toasts-2025-hiring-binge/813462/?utm_source=openai))
  - In November 2025, Toast reported a 25% year-over-year revenue increase to $1.6 billion and an 88% rise in net profit to $105 million for the third quarter. Despite these strong financials, investor concerns about market saturation and consumer spending have influenced stock performance. ([forbes.com](https://www.forbes.com/sites/jeffkauflin/2025/11/05/toasts-stock-jumps-10-after-earnings-report-but-investor-concerns-continue-to-weigh-it-down/?ss=fintech&utm_source=openai))
  - In September 2025, Toast's stock experienced a decline following reports of pricing pressures in the lower-end market segments, indicating intensified competition in casual dining and quick-service restaurants. ([investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/toast-stock-drops-as-evercore-isi-notes-pricing-pressure-in-lowerend-market-93CH-4250054?utm_source=openai))

Please note that while Toast has demonstrated significant growth and resilience, it continues to navigate challenges related to market competition and consumer behavior.
